description: Capital Integrity Dossier: a deep, section-by-section treasury report on one of the DeFi protocols scored by TCS-6 (treasury-capital-score). MULTI-CALL, DISCLOSED UP FRONT: a full dossier takes up to 7 calls (up to $0.035 at $0.005 per call). For your security and cost control, call POST /v1/dossier/plan {entity_id} first: it returns a dossier_id, the available sections, calls_required and the estimated total before you commit, and you pay only for the calls you make. Then call POST /v1/dossier/section {dossier_id, section} once per section, in any order, stopping whenever you like; every response shows calls_used and calls_remaining. Sections: holdings_map (every position, value, haircut, price source), authority_graph (Safe thresholds, signers, shared signers), obligations_register, exit_liquidity (locked and encumbered positions, loan health), reconciliation (reported vs observed total), unresolved_items. A dossier_id pins one TCS-6 snapshot for 24 hours, so every section describes the same moment. Each section carries the signed TCS-6 attestation reference. POST /v1/dossier/entities {} lists the covered protocols. Every response is one JSON object of derived values and citations, never raw vendor data. ONE-CALL OPTION: POST /v1/dossier/availability {entity_id} ($0.005) splits the verified treasury into available now, own token, loan collateral, restricted, illiquid now and unresolved, summing to the observed total. Research, not investment advice.

rpc_types.notes: POST /v1/dossier/plan, /v1/dossier/section, /v1/dossier/entities, /v1/dossier/availability; GET /v1/version, /v1/health. JSON body only. Malformed input, an unknown entity or an expired dossier_id returns 400 + JSON. A section the snapshot cannot support is a 200 with available false; plan lists it as unavailable and leaves it out of calls_required.

serving.backend: Node.js HTTP server (zero npm dependencies) behind a RelayMiner at http://<container>:8080. No caller auth. Reads the TCS-6 data volume read-only; never calls a chain or a vendor on the relay path.

healthcheck.notes: Functional probe with a deterministic expected value.

serving.notes: Gateway operators: configure as type passthrough with rpc_types ["rest"].
